rules.rule: Review Lean proof changes for semantic correctness, unsound shortcuts, changed trust boundaries, brittle simp usage, missing theorem coverage, accidental weakening of statements, and interactions with AUDIT.md/TRUST_ASSUMPTIONS.md/AXIOMS.md. Do not request stylistic rewrites unless they reduce proof fragility. Prefer high-confidence findings only.

Review automation and CI changes for command injection, unsafe path handling, credential exposure, nondeterminism, missing failure handling, and divergence from documented project commands. Prefer high-confidence findings only.
Review documentation changes for contradictions with code, trust-boundary drift, stale commands, and missing updates to related docs. Avoid wording nitpicks.
